title: Claude Code Tutorial for Beginners: From Install to Your First Autonomous Task
summary: Step-by-step Claude Code tutorial for beginners. Install in 2 minutes, configure CLAUDE.md, run your first autonomous task, and deploy a real app.
body_markdown:
Launch Claude Code for the first time:


```text
claude
```


Claude Code opens a browser window on first launch. Sign in with your Anthropic account. Your credentials are stored locally — you won't be prompted again.


If you're using the Anthropic API directly (Console access), export your API key instead:


```text
export   ANTHROPIC_API_KEY  =  "sk-ant-..."
```


For persistent access without re-exporting, add that line to your` ~/.zshrc` or` ~/.bashrc` :


```text
echo   'export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="sk-ant-..."'   >>   ~/.zshrc
source   ~/.zshrc
```


Never commit your API key to git. Add` ~/.claude` to your global` .gitignore` and never paste your key value into any tracked file.
